key_decisions: THE COLOUR FIX IS A DISPLAY SPLIT, NEVER AN EXPORT SPLIT. MaskManager.autoCanvas holds (union of selected autoPickMasks) AND NOT subtract, purely so MpiCanvas can tint it green. getURL() / getMaskDataURL() still flatten the single unioned maskCanvas that every downstream mask consumer reads. Do not leak the split into an export path.
_recompositeAuto() returns early when nothing is selected, so the per-dab brush hot path pays nothing for the extra pass. Keep that guard if you refactor it.

_recolorMaskLayer(src, color, W, H) fills source-atop inside a SCRATCH BUFFER on purpose - filling on the overlay directly would recolour the comparison layer painted underneath. The buffer is reused across frames AND across both calls in one frame, which is safe because drawImage copies synchronously.

Canvas colours are module constants mirroring styles/01_base.css tokens (MASK_AUTO_FILL, MASK_INVERT_FILL, MASK_POINT_*). JS cannot read CSS vars in a per-frame draw. Update the constant when the token changes.

MASK TOOL FAMILY (user, 2026-07-28): Points / Detect / Shapes (MPI-368) / Text (MPI-361 Phase B). ONE ICON PER TOOL inside the existing MASK rail group - no switcher, revisit only if the family outgrows the rail. Settings persist. The shared strip must make the brush + eraser pair OPTIONAL because the Points tool has no use for them; invert, clear and opacity are on every tool.

TEXT MASKING IS PHASE B OF MPI-361, not a new card. SAM3_Detect + CLIPTextEncode conditioning. Its threshold gates TEXT detections ONLY - it is not the point-path confidence dial, so the Scope slider stays wired to the Impact path or the UI must explain the split.

Add / Subtract is APP-SIDE via MaskManager.bakeAutoPicksInto(), which writes BOTH layers the way paint() does: adding un-erases, subtracting un-paints. No AddMask/SubtractMask nodes, no extra round trip, undo preserved, composes with the brush. It is mode-agnostic, which is why un-gating it for the YOLO detector was one line.

Dot polarity is carried by RADIUS, not a separate mask: r=8 positive, r=4 negative, straddling the exact 10px bbox-width cliff that mask_hint_use_negative='Small' uses. Proven live at 6.10x separation.

The dots mask is rendered at SOURCE image resolution, NOT the MASK_MAX_EDGE-capped working size - SEG coords must line up with the image SAMDetectorCombined receives, and the negative cliff is measured in that image's own pixels.
The old YOLO detector path is KEPT as the fast one-click Face / Hair / Hand / Person shortcut. Points sit BESIDE it.
constraints: N DOTS DO NOT GIVE N OBJECTS. Every point goes into ONE sam_obj.predict call, so SAM returns a SINGLE region consistent with ALL points. One part per run is the shape of the feature; Add accumulates parts across runs.

threshold is NOT a smooth confidence. sam_predict keeps every SAM candidate scoring >= threshold and unions them, falling back to the single best if none pass. SAM emits 3 candidates, so the dial SNAPS between 3 states and 0.50 -> 0.60 is usually identical. Sweep it, do not nudge it.

dilation STAYS AT 0 - it blindly grows whatever SAM returned, scatter included. The scatter cleanup pair (GrowMaskWithBlur -4 then +4 with fill_holes) MUST stay equal and opposite or the mask grows or shrinks overall.

MpiCanvasViewer has its own contextmenu handler on its root, so InputController's points-mode handler calls stopPropagation AS WELL AS preventDefault. That line is load-bearing. Leaving the mask tool MUST call setMaskPointsMode(false) or right-click stays broken.

MpiAutoMaskThumbs.setPicks() deliberately does NOT emit 'change'. Points mode relies on that to restore pick 0 after setImages() clears the selection without re-triggering the run. Do not 'fix' it while moving code around.

A tool swap must NOT wipe manualCanvas / subtractCanvas - that is the user's work. Only the auto layer is disposable. Today the panel is one component so the question never came up; after the split every mount/unmount is a chance to lose it.

THE WORKFLOW CONVERTER HAS BLAST RADIUS. Running `node scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs` with NO ARGUMENTS re-emits ALL 31 workflows and writes 15 stray comfy_workflows/*_template.json files. Convert ONE file: `node scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs comfy_workflows/raw/img_auto_mask.json` prints to stdout, then write it with JSON.stringify(wf, null, 2) plus a trailing newline.
Every new component registers its .css in js/shell/preloadStyles.js AND documents its props in js/components/types.js. Never modify js/components/factory.js (locked).

The working tree carries changes that are NOT from this work and must not be committed with it: js/data/modelConstants/models.js, .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-353/, and untracked tasks/MPI-355 + tasks/MPI-358. Commit by explicit pathspec only - never git add -A.
